story.title: Story 5: Attach And Import Existing PI Sessions

result.planSummary: Fixed the verifier blockers by serializing the full attach/import operation against same-thread live capture, reusing the capture internals without double-locking, and narrowing partial-import repair marking to the source ranges of actual import issues.

changedFiles.reason: Exposed an internal capture helper so import can hold the per-thread serializer across the whole operation without deadlocking canonical capture.
Wrapped thread creation and import finalization in the same thread operation and scoped repair_needed turn marking to issue source ranges.
Added estimated source ranges to skipped PI path-entry issues so structural partial imports can be repaired narrowly.
Added live-capture/import overlap regression coverage and updated partial-import expectations to mark only affected turns repair_needed.

added: serializes live capture behind an in-progress import so it cannot land inside the imported range
modified: marks only affected imported turns repair_needed when one imported message is partial

findingsFixed: SV-05-01: same-session live capture now queues behind an in-progress attach/import and cannot receive a sourceOrder inside the imported source range.
SV-05-02: partial import repair_needed marking now applies only to turns whose source ranges overlap actual issue ranges while Thread status.turnState remains repair_needed.
findingsSurfaced: npm run verify-all passed; the integration test leg reported no integration tests found in the current project layout.

result.recommendedNextStep: Run fresh story verification against Story 5 to confirm SV-05-01 and SV-05-02 are cleared.
